rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Official Google Cloud BigQuery remote MCP server that provides AI assistants with direct access to BigQuery resources and data analysis capabilities. Unlike local MCP servers, this remote implementation runs on Google's managed infrastructure with HTTPS endpoints, fine-grained IAM authorization, optional Model Armor security scanning, and centralized audit logging. The server enables understanding user intent, examining BigQuery resources, generating and executing SQL queries, and interpreting results, making it valuable for building conversational data analysis workflows, creating forecasting insights, and triggering actions based on BigQuery data discoveries.
